events.title: Launch date announcement!
events.summary: I am thrilled to announce that Ascended Snake will launch on Tuesday, October 27! The game will go live at 17:00 CET.In the full version you will be able to:Start from scratch or continue from the demo progress!Discover the 3 new maps to continue growing.Buy more upgrades.Unlock the Ascension with its perk system.Try the new skin compared to the demo, the limousine.After unlocking the Ascension, change between the initial game mode and the Ascension mode.How much will it cost?The base price of A

events.title: Demo Update!
events.summary: Thanks everyone for the feedback!Most of the changes come from that!demo version 0.2.0ADDED:Variety of movement soundEnriched tiled backgroundVegetation outside the playable areaSkin system with 2 new skins!Game version in the bottom right cornerIMPROVEMENTS:UI navigation focusSave system robustnessMinor fixes & PolishRelated to loading of assets, UI sizes and positions, and input.Also, I am very excited to announce Ascended Snake will be participating in Steam Next Fest: October 2026. events.title: Demo Release Announcement!
events.summary: Demo release on September 1st!Demo ContentThe demo is expected to last 20-30 minutes. Giving an idea of the basic gameplay of the game before unlocking other systems above it.Progress will be transferable to the game!When starting the full game for the first time, the save file of the demo will be searched and if it exists, you will be given the option to continue your progress. If continued, the corresponding achievements will also be unlocked.Please share your feedback!You can write here, in D
